name: Exact perspective projection of AMR cells
definition: A method to render perspective images of AMR cells exactly by computing the pixel average of the integral of the quantity along each ray from the camera. It is implemented in pynbody.imaging._render_amr_perspective.
summary: Exact perspective projection of AMR cells renders perspective images by computing pixel averages of integrals along rays, ensuring geometric fidelity by avoiding orthographic approximations.
